BBC Sky at Night Magazine is essential reading for both the novice and experienced astronomer. When you subscribe to the popular astronomy magazine each month you will receive:

  • Easy-to-follow star charts
  • Expert advice on how to get the most out of the observing month
  • Columns by renowned experts
  • In-depth cosmological features and equipment reviews
